title: trufflehog-orb run record, version 1
description: What one trufflehog-orb scan ran, on what, with which TruffleHog, and what it found, without any part of a secret: written as <report_name>.run-record.json when the scan command's run_record parameter is true. Fields are only ever added within version 1; a change that would break a reader gets a new schema URL.

command.description: The orb command that wrote the record.

outcome.description: passed: no secrets at or above fail_on. findings: secrets failed the step. findings-reported: secrets, passed because report_only is true. error: the scan did not complete, reported a scan error, or scanned nothing, so there is no verdict, and the step failed.

exit_code.description: 1 when the outcome is error, else 0. The step's own exit code also depends on report_only.

ci.description: The CI job the command ran in: a CircleCI job (from CIRCLE_BUILD_URL, CIRCLE_SHA1, CIRCLE_JOB and the project), or a GitHub Actions run (from GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT, GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_JOB); null elsewhere.

working_directory.description: The absolute directory the command ran in. Relative paths in arguments and target are relative to it.

tool.description: The trufflehog that ran, with its SHA-512; null when it was not found.

version.description: What trufflehog --version reports, without a leading v.

arguments.description: The TruffleHog source (git or filesystem) and the options that decide what it scanned and reported, such as --since-commit, --branch, --no-verification and --results; without the options the command adds to read its output (--json, --no-update, --no-color), and without the target, which is in target. URLs lose their userinfo, query and fragment.

scope.description: For source git: changes, history or all.

repository.description: For source git: the top of the checkout.

head.description: For source git: the commit HEAD was.

base.description: For scope changes: the merge base the scan started after.

base_from.description: For scope changes: what the merge base was taken with, such as origin/main, base_ref main, or the pull request's base.

commits.description: For source git: how many commits were in the range, by git rev-list.

shallow.description: For source git: whether the checkout is a shallow clone, which holds only part of the history.

partial_clone.description: For source git: whether the checkout is a partial clone (such as CircleCI's blobless checkout), which lacks objects until git fetches them from a promisor remote.

fetched_objects.description: For a partial clone: how many objects were fetched into it before the scan, since TruffleHog clones the checkout and git serves no clone from a repository that lacks objects. Null when nothing was fetched first: not a partial clone, a scan with no commits, or --trust-local-git-config, with which TruffleHog scans the checkout where it is.

paths.description: For source filesystem: the paths scanned.

verification.description: Whether TruffleHog checked the secrets it found with the services they belong to (verify).

scan.description: TruffleHog's own summary of the scan, from its "finished scanning" log line; null when it didn't run (no commits to scan) or ended before it.

counts.description: What the findings report holds; null when there is no report.

failing.description: The secrets at or above fail_on.

detectors.description: How many secrets each detector found.

reports.description: The report files written before the record, with their SHA-256.
